snippet.title: Sonnet - Official Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Sonnet tells the story of Maisey, a young adventurer burdened with the task of transporting a magical flower across a medieval road trip. Journey across scenic lands, encounter strange travelers, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets when 'Sonnet Part I: The Gardener of Smoke' launches in late 2026.
